truthfulness.note: All six tools are read-only planners. Current/frozen shortcuts and menu invocations establish exact symbols and labels only. With no command-specific DCL/config/data/readable implementation, every topology or table result is explicit caller-reviewed input and no legacy-equivalence claim is made.
